Privacy policy

The data you entrust to us, how it is used and your rights.

Document under legal review: the information below must be completed by the restaurant and checked by a legal professional before the site goes live.

Data collected

The site only collects personal data when you send a reservation request through the form:

  • your full name;
  • your email address and phone number;
  • the requested date, time and number of guests;
  • the optional message you add;
  • the language in which you browse the site.

Purpose

This data is used solely to process your reservation request and reply to you. It is neither used for marketing nor shared with third parties.

Legal basis

Processing is based on your consent, given by ticking the box provided before sending the form. Without this consent the request cannot be sent; you can always contact the restaurant by phone or WhatsApp.

Recipients

Your data is intended for the restaurant. It passes through the following technical service providers, who only access it to provide their service:

Hosting provider

Your rights

In accordance with Law No. 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data, you have the right to access and rectify your data and, on legitimate grounds, to object to its processing. To exercise these rights, write to:

Personal data contact
[LEGAL INFORMATION TO BE CONFIRMED]

National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection (CNDP)

The formalities applicable with the CNDP are being verified by the restaurant; their reference will appear below. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNDP:

www.cndp.ma

CNDP declaration reference
[LEGAL INFORMATION TO BE CONFIRMED]

Third-party services

  • WhatsApp: the WhatsApp button opens a conversation with a pre-filled message that you send yourself; the exchange is then governed by WhatsApp’s terms.
  • Google Maps: the access map is only loaded when you ask for it, by clicking “Show the interactive map”; Google then receives the usual technical data (IP address, browser).
  • Online booking system: if offered, its module is only loaded when you ask for it and is governed by its provider’s terms.

Cookies

The site sets no cookies and uses no audience measurement tool. Should this change, this policy would be updated beforehand.

Security

Exchanges with the site are encrypted. Requests are not stored in a database on the site: they are sent to the restaurant by email. The reservation service’s technical logs contain no personal data; the hosting provider may however keep technical connection logs.
